label: input token u in the original phase (not at step 1 or step 7+)
explanation: A token detector for the letter u while the original sequence is being read. Essentially all activation (>99.9% of mass) is on steps where the input is u and t < L. It never fires on u at step 1, almost never at step 7 or later, and it is weaker and less reliable at step 2 (and at t=0); most mass sits at steps 3-5. It is silent on the delimiter and in the copy phase, including when u is fed back as a copy input, and silent on every other token. The strongest activations (top examples) come in sequences that start with q / contain an earlier q: q-seen steps make up 10% of active steps but 16% of mass. Repeat u occurrences fire weaker than the first u.

issues: The core claim holds. On test the predicate gets P 0.825, R 0.994, F1 0.902, mass recall 0.998. The feature is silent at the delimiter (0 active steps), and u fed back in the copy phase scores P 0.0002. Steps 1 and 8+ are fully silent, and step 7 is near-silent (P 0.065 on u).

Systematic false-positive class: at t=2, whether u fires depends strongly on the first token of the sequence. Precision on u at t=2, split by first token: first in {b,e,g,n,q,u,w,z,0,2} gives 0.84-1.0. First in {a,d,i,k,m,r,v} gives 0.0-0.09. The explanation calls step 2 'weaker and less reliable' but misses this rule, and the t=2 cases make up most of the 14.5k false positives in test misses. t=6 (P 0.60) is also partial; it rises to 0.84 when the first token is in that set.
The claim that t=0 is 'less reliable' is wrong. u at t=0 has precision 1.0: it fires on every u at t=0 and is only weaker in size (24% of active steps, 7.7% of mass).

The claim that repeat occurrences of u fire more weakly is not supported. in_first==0 covers 10.6% of active steps but 15.8% of the mass, so repeats are stronger on average. This is probably because repeats sit at later steps, but as stated the claim is backwards.
The q-history claim checks out: steps with q already seen are 10.3% of active steps and carry 16.5% of the mass.
skeptic.revised_label: input token u in the original phase, fires on every u at t=0 and t=3-5, never at t=1 or t>=8; at t=2 (and partly t=6) only when the first token is one of b,e,g,n,q,u,w,z,0,2

final_label: input token u in the original phase, fires on every u at t=0 and t=3-5, never at t=1 or t>=8; at t=2 (and partly t=6) only when the first token is one of b,e,g,n,q,u,w,z,0,2
